pages.text: Every morning, an ice-selling boat arrived. Thick cloth covered the ice blocks. Still, they melted as the sun rose.
Bung wanted a piece to nibble, one each with Ddori. "I will buy them later."
The sun rose a little. Bung played floating leaves on the water.
Ddori pointed to the ice boat. Bung waved a hand. "A little more play first."
The sun climbed overhead. The boat floor felt hot.
Bung went to the ice boat. Only water sloshed in the tub.
The ice seller took the last piece from the bottom and put it in Ddori's hand. Already, it melted and dripped.
Grandpa peered into the empty tub. "The sun ate the ice first."
Next morning, Bung ran over as soon as the ice boat sounded.
Bung and Ddori each nibbled a piece of ice. Cold cheeks made both their eyes widen.
